markers.description: Rockwood Apartment Homes is an apartment community in north Austin, serving as a private home-base stay for the journey.
markers.name: Rockwood Apartment Homes

markers.description: Cork & Pig Tavern is a San Angelo-born Texas tavern chain, with this Abilene, Texas, location serving wood-fired pizzas, craft cocktails, and casual American fare.
markers.name: Cork & Pig Tavern

markers.description: This address served as a private home-base stay in Amarillo, Texas, during the Panhandle portion of the journey.
markers.name: 4803 Mc Kinley Ln

markers.description: OVR-EZE is a breakfast and brunch restaurant in Amarillo, Texas, serving inventive dishes like the Croi-ffle, a waffle pressed from croissant dough.
markers.name: OVR-EZE

markers.description: Palo Duro Canyon State Park near Amarillo protects the second-largest canyon in the United States, famed for red-rock cliffs and the Lighthouse formation.
markers.name: Palo Duro Canyon State Park

markers.description: The Big Texan Steak Ranch & Brewery is a Route 66-era steakhouse in Amarillo, Texas, home of the 72-ounce steak challenge.
markers.name: The Big Texan Steak Ranch & Brewery

markers.description: Cadillac Ranch is a public art installation west of Amarillo where 10 graffiti-covered Cadillacs stand buried nose-first in a field.
markers.name: Cadillac Ranch

markers.description: Jimmy's Egg is a regional breakfast and lunch chain restaurant in Amarillo, Texas, serving omelets, pancakes, and classic diner fare.
markers.name: Jimmy's Egg

markers.description: Caprock Canyons State Park & Trailway near Quitaque, Texas, features rugged red canyons and is home to the official Texas State Bison Herd.
markers.name: Caprock Canyons State Park & Trailway

markers.description: Allsup's is a convenience store chain widespread across New Mexico and West Texas, with this Spur, Texas, location serving as a practical stop for fuel and snacks.
markers.name: Allsup's Convenience Store
